authorial_core.source_request:
[러브크래프트 공포 용어 정리](chatgpt-conversation://6ad9bf09-c888-83ec-a092-36fbff61fd93) 에서 조사한 키워드를 바탕으로 시각 의미 데이터, 후보 데이터를 충분히 강화하기 위한 상세한 리서치를 진행해줘. 리서치 결과를 어떻게 반영할지 계획까지 세워줘.
시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 주제에 어울리는 랜덤한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
보강하고 다시 테스트해줘.
authorial_core.interpreted_intent: Independently interpret Lovecraftian horror as cosmic dread when human scale and familiar understanding meet an incomprehensible nonhuman order. The appearance-guided woman is the human witness; use the supplied portrait for face and hair, with no assertion of personal identity. The randomly selected freight-elevator setting, trolley, threshold, alien membrane anatomy, halted gesture, camera, clothes and all light are replaceable agent staging. A quiet routine stopped by an indifferent living immensity should read before any lore label. Keep the face legible enough for reference review while the doorway and first several connected membrane layers share the frame. Saved controls are sensual=1, fetish=0, surreal=0, creativity=1: subtle natural human presence, restrained staging, and only the impossible content inherent to the requested horror.
authorial_core.subject: A portrait-appearance-guided woman encountering a vast unfamiliar nonhuman presence.
authorial_core.setting: An old municipal service corridor with an open freight elevator revealing an immense living interior; this place is agent-owned.
authorial_core.event: A routine trolley trip stops at a doorway as the woman perceives an alien living order whose extent exceeds the familiar building; the exact action and apparatus are agent-owned.
visual_priorities: A recognizable human face and halted practical gesture establish the scale and personal consequence of the encounter.
A complete ordinary elevator doorframe borders a single continuous organism with physically readable near membranes and a much greater receding extent.
The creature's indifferent spatial continuity dominates while the woman's quiet directed attention keeps the situation understandable.
authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: A photographic moment of cosmic horror, with human scale overwhelmed by an incomprehensible nonhuman presence. Use the supplied portrait as face-and-hair appearance guidance: a woman with a soft oval face, large brown eyes and natural pink lips, and a glossy dark chin-length bob with airy bangs. Her clothing and body are designed for this scene. She has stopped a small empty freight trolley one step short of the open elevator in an old municipal service corridor. She stands on the corridor floor outside the threshold, her right hand resting around the trolley handle, her elbow close to her side. Her face is in a readable three-quarter view, eyes fixed past the doorway; her lips have parted before a breath, while the trolley has stopped squarely against her thigh. Her dark knit sleeveless top, bare neck and softly lit cheek give her a quiet, personal presence against the mechanical surroundings. This is an encounter with an alien order that does not acknowledge its human observer. Beyond the worn steel doorframe, one continuous pearl-grey organism fills an immense living interior. Upright ribbed membranes separate into successive fan-shaped chambers around a common black opening. Translucent branching vessels cross the smooth membranes. The nearest membrane is taller than the elevator doors; the same connected body repeats into a depth the narrow shaft cannot contain. Its folds run through the expected floor and rear wall as if the small building were only a thin cut across its scale. The woman faces a presence whose visible extent defeats the familiar room, caught in the instant when a routine trip has become impossible to continue. Photograph from the corridor, at chest height with a restrained 35 mm perspective, looking diagonally across the woman's front-left side toward the open doors. A horizontal frame holds her from mid-thigh upward in the near left third, with her face large enough to recognize and the complete doorframe and receding membranes occupying the right two-thirds. Warm, worn corridor light falls over her face and trolley; a cold diffuse glow comes through the creature's layered tissue. Keep both the near human features and first several layers of the organism legible, allowing the far repetition to recede into darkness. Real steel scuffs, dust at the sill, ordinary knit texture and natural skin render this impossible event as an observed photograph. The central contrast is her small halted practical gesture against the vast indifferent continuity beyond the door.

interpretation_provenance.resolution: Cosmic horror from human insignificance and the encounter with an incomprehensible nonhuman order; neither a fixed monster design nor an action attack is necessary. The doorway, membrane anatomy and trolley are optional staging.

Directly viewed supplied portrait guides face and hair appearance. Image generation and evaluation are workflow duties; clothing, body, gesture and environment are open. The portrait supplies appearance rather than a verified personal identity.

recognizable human presence beside vast continuous alien tissue
